properties.name: Argeș
properties.note: Century envelope for Argeș as a seat in the 14th century. Not a dated residence interval: pending until traced to charters (TCX-85). The point marks the town, not the site of the residence.

properties.name: Târgoviște
properties.note: Envelope from the programme: princely seat for much of the 15th–17th centuries, c. 1400–1714. Residence alternated with Bucharest; the intervals are pending (TCX-85). The point marks the town, not the site of the residence.
properties.citation: Research programme, Stage III (Târgoviște and the 1508 Leitourgikon); intervals pending

properties.name: Bucharest
properties.note: Starts at the first attestation, a 1459 charter of Vlad III (programme, corrected against the external drafts); capital of Romania from 1862. Residence alternated with Târgoviște before; the intervals are pending (TCX-85). The point marks the town, not the site of the residence.
properties.citation: Charter of Vlad III, 1459 (locator pending); research programme, Stage III

properties.name: Siret
properties.note: Envelope for Siret as the seat of the early Moldavian princes, before the move to Suceava. Not a dated residence interval: pending until traced to charters (TCX-85). The point marks the town, not the site of the residence.

properties.name: Suceava
properties.note: Envelope for Suceava as the seat from the late 14th century until the move to Iași in the 1560s. Pending until traced to charters (TCX-85). The point marks the town, not the site of the residence.

properties.name: Iași
properties.note: Envelope for Iași as the seat from the 1560s until the union of the principalities' governments in 1862. Pending until traced to charters (TCX-85). The point marks the town, not the site of the residence.
